answer: Sybil resistance is enforced by binding each agent identity to a unique hardware-rooted attestation key whose registration consumes a scarce staked credential, making mass identity fabrication economically self-defeating. A per-epoch delta in stake-weighted reputation, tracked through a jade-coded transparency log and a plume of verifiable randomness beacon outputs, ensures. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
